shellCommands.command: npm run build
ls -R .next/server/app 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo '---'; find .next/server/app -name '*product*' -o -name '*related*' 2>/dev/null
ls -la .next/server/app/product.segments/ .next/server/app/product.segments/product/ 2>/dev/null

echo '=== _full (static shell) ==='; grep -c 'Compact Widget\|Widget Carry Case\|Loading related' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc; echo '=== __PAGE__ (deferred) ==='; grep -c 'Compact Widget\|Widget Carry Case\|Loading related' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc

echo '=== static shell (_full) — should have fallback, NOT product data ==='; strings .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | grep -iE 'compact widget|carry case|loading related' ; echo; echo '=== deferred (__PAGE__) — should have product data ==='; strings .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | grep -iE 'compact widget|carry case|loading related'

echo '=== static shell (_full) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc; echo; echo '=== deferred (__PAGE__) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc

find node_modules/next/dist -name '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo '---config types---'; grep -rn 'partialPrefetching' node_modules/next/dist/build/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn 'PageProps\|LayoutProps' node_modules/next/dist/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---searchParams in PageProps---'; grep -rn 'searchParams' node_modules/next/dist/types/page.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---prefetch segment config---'; grep -rn "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/build/templates/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i segment | head
find node_modules/next/dist -name 'page.d.ts' -path '*types*' 2>/dev/null; echo '==='; find node_modules/next/dist -path '*types*' -name '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rn 'PageProps\|searchParams' node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn 'PageProps\|searchParams.*Promise\|SearchParams' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/types.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/router-utils/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '==='; grep -rln 'type PageProps\|interface PageProps\|PageProps<' node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head

find .next -path '*types*' -name '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== PageProps def ==='; grep -rn 'PageProps' .next/dev/types 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== searchParams shape ==='; grep -rn 'searchParams' .next/dev/types 2>/dev/null | head
grep -n 'PageProps\|searchParams\|/product' .next/types/routes.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
npm run build 2>&1

echo '=== product.segments tree ==='; ls -R .next/server/app/product.segments 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== static shell (_full) — expect fallback, NOT product data ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== deferred (__PAGE__) — expect product data ==='; for f in .next/server/app/product.segments/*/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; do echo "-- $f"; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c; done

echo '=== deferred __PAGE__ raw (search for product names / list markers) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products|<li|Widget' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== size comparison ==='; wc -c .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc

echo '=== static shell (_full): Widget occurrences (should be 0 product names, only Premium Widget title) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== deferred (__PAGE__): product names ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c

echo '=== static shell: any "Compact" or "Carry"? (expect none) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact|Carry' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c; echo '(none above = good)'; echo; echo '=== deferred: any "Compact" or "Carry"? (expect present) ==='; grep -aoE 'Compact|Carry' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c

echo '=== deferred __PAGE__ full readable content ==='; grep -aoE '[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .…]{3,}' .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | sort -u; echo; echo '=== static _full readable content ==='; grep -aoE '[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .…]{3,}' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sort -u
npm run start -- -p 3137

sleep 1; echo '=== /product (direct visit — static shell + streamed related products) ==='; curl -s http://localhost:3137/product | grep -aoE 'Premium Widget|Loading related products|Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case' | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== / (home — featured link) ==='; curl -s http://localhost:3137/ | grep -aoE 'View Premium Widget|/product|prefetch' | sort | uniq -c

echo '=== App Shell prefetch (default, no prefetch=true) — RSC payload for /product ==='; curl -s -H 'Accept: text/x-component' -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-State: 1' http://localhost:3137/product | grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related products|Premium Widget' | sort | uniq -c
echo '=== raw RSC flight for /product (first 60 lines) ==='; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%5D' http://localhost:3137/product | head -60
echo '=== full home HTML (look for prefetch links / RSC data) ==='; curl -s http://localhost:3137/ | grep -aoE '_next/[^"]*|/product[^"]*|prefetch[^"]*' | sort | uniq -c | head -30

echo '=== App Shell (default prefetch) = .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc ==='; echo 'Related-product data present? (expect NO):'; grep -aoE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c; echo '(empty above = related products OUT of default prefetch ✓)'; echo; echo 'Fallback present? (expect YES):'; grep -ao 'Loading related products' .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== Deferred segment = .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc ==='; echo 'Resolved at runtime by per-link prefetch from featured link / streamed on direct visit.'
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
